name: android_simulate_biometric
description: Simulates a fingerprint touch (success: an enrolled finger; failure: an unknown one). Works only on Android emulators (`adb emu finger touch`); physical devices return an error.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

success.description: True to simulate authenticated biometric match, false for rejected match.
